title: Chapter 472
paragraphs: Chapter 472
Episode 132. Massacre, and Strange......(6)
'What... what's happening?'
Myron and Midor felt a strange sensation as if something was being drained from their bodies.
A soul, or perhaps a spirit. That was what had left their bodies.
It was simply unreal.
Complete destruction from just a single breath; no, the term destruction wasn't enough. What kind of ship had turned to 'dust'?
The mass-produced ship, modeled after Cozak, Zyphl's decisive weapon known as the "power to destroy the world."

Although it was a mass-produced ship, even Cozak's developers had assured that it could reach more than 50% of the original's maximum performance. It wasn't something that could be easily made like a mass-produced item.
In other words, it was a ship that should never have been shattered so easily. The 'Cozak 2 Myron' was a ship made to rule the world.
Hududuk, tuduk, tok...!
The ship was now just pouring down like rain.

Earlier, it was a rain of black spikes, and now it was a rain of debris from the shattered giant ship. Countless, tens of thousands of randomly broken fragments darkened the air like swarms of insects.
In fact, if Myron and the passengers had been fully prepared from the beginning and had activated the proper shield as soon as they appeared, they wouldn't have been so utterly defeated.
'My, my shi... ship...! My Cozak 2 Myron!'
It was smashed to pieces.
Myron's pupils, blue like a bruise, were filled with deep red bloodshot.
Was it just the ship that was destroyed?
No. Among the debris pouring down like rain, there were not only the ship's materials but also human flesh and bones.
Hundreds of magicians who were on board the ship were also annihilated.
Moreover, it was the debut battle for Cozak 2 Myron and the magicians after their 'resurrection.' The opponents of their debut battle were Jin and Murakan, who had killed Myron.
There couldn't be a better debut stage, but the result was so miserable!
[What's up, are you crying? Is that guy crying right now?]
Murakan raised one eyebrow and narrowed his eyes.
Although the distance was quite far and the debris was blocking the view, it seemed like he could see the tears glistening at Myron's eyes.
"Bro, Brother! Myron, Brother Myron!"
Midor's desperate voice calling Myron was so hoarse that it made a squeaking sound.
Thanks to that, the already crumbling dignity and atmosphere became even more ridiculous, but it wasn't the time to be embarrassed.
"Brother, you need to hold on to your sanity, Myron, Brother Myron!"
[Ah.]
[Hey, show me something before you lose your minds. Especially you! Having come back to life after dying, you should at least be an amusing sight for me, Murakan, right?]
Murakan snorted as if the brothers' bewildered situation was unbearable.
And Vugo and the knights of Runecandel were making a misunderstanding once again. They didn't know that the performance of Coject2 Myron was inferior to the original.
Of course, it was only natural. The Coject2 Myron and the summoning cube had just been revealed to the world for the first time.
'Breaking Coject with just one breath?'
'Coject?'
'No, that ship was even bigger than Coject. In my opinion, the only person in the world who could destroy Coject like this is my father.'
The members of Bement also had the same thoughts as Runecandel.
In their common sense, it was impossible to end a Coject-class ship with just one breath unless one was the world's only star knight, Sirron Runecandel.
The rumors about Murakan's power grew even more absurdly huge.
'Ha, back then, he didn't seem like such a character who would whine and cry like that. Isn't that right, kid?'
Jin didn't respond, but fixed his gaze on Myron, Midor, and the cube he was holding.
To be exact, it wasn't that he didn't answer, but he couldn't. Unlike Murakan and all the other forces, Jin was also at a loss for words.
However, it wasn't because of Murakan's power like the other forces.
There were some facts that everyone had forgotten while watching the shocking sight of the ship being shattered by one breath.
First of all, resurrection.
Myron seemed to have been resurrected in a way that was not like using the Tears of Numerus.

'Myron's resurrection must also be like Sandra's regeneration, powered by the Devil Stone. No wonder I've been uncomfortable with not being able to secure Myron's body because of the support of the Zipple headquarters back then.'
Myron's resurrection occurred after the 'new Devil Stone' was produced.
Initially, when the body was recovered by Zipple, Luna had destroyed Zipple's first Devil Stone. The very Devil Stone that Andrey Zipple had.
Jin was reminded of the words he had said to Barton Vichena during the Black Knight assassination mission.
In fact, the resurrection itself was not so surprising. He had already experienced the Devil Stone reviving Bulletta during his battle with Andrey in his preparatory Knight days.
What really surprised Jin was the existence of the 'cube'.
'What on earth is that cube?'
It didn't seem to be a Devil Stone. It didn't seem likely that Midor would have such an important item at this moment. And it looked completely different from the one Andrey had.
'Although it could have been improved and changed in appearance, it doesn't have that unique creepy feeling. Above all, Murakan doesn't react much to that thing either.'
The Devil Stone instinctively causes fear in dragons. Although Murakan showed immunity when fighting Andrey, Quicanthal was virtually incapacitated as soon as he saw the Devil Stone.
Then the answer was simple.
"New technology, a new means of warfare."
I couldn't figure out how the cube worked. However, its purpose was very clear.
Summoning.
"It's a kind of transportation portal. It's much smaller and more powerful than the existing portals. It might even be more amazing than I can imagine or speculate."
There were no transportation portals currently in use that could accommodate this many people at once. Let alone moving a massive flying battleship, which was utterly impossible.
Thump, thump!
Suddenly, my heart pounded like a hammer.
In front of me was a sample symbolizing the 'never leaked top technology' of Runecandel, the greatest enemy of the world's number one.
"Perhaps the reason why Joshua and other top knights of other factions went somewhere other than Gaipa Military Road is related to that technology."
If I could possess it, it could be an even greater harvest than (tentative ally) Amela.
[Still squeezing. Ah, I hate seeing it. Just die already, it's annoying.]
Hoo-oo-oop!
Murakan was gathering his breath again to kill Mu-ron, Midor, and the remaining remnants.
"Stop, Murakan!"
[Ke-hek, kek!]
Murakan, who was about to release his breath, hastily closed his throat and coughed.
[Why all of a sudden?]
Jin was already rushing towards Midor with his eyes wide open.
"Damn it!"
Kwang! Bang!
Midor desperately unleashed a spatial explosion to prevent Jin from approaching.
However, the spatial explosion couldn't easily penetrate Moolta's rune and spiritual armor. The Jin Midor encountered in Colon and the Jin now were completely different beings.
Midor also tried extremely hard to become stronger for revenge, but the original disposition and determination were different.
It was an insurmountable difference.
"I've never forgotten the trouble you gave me in Colon, Midor Elna."
Swoosh!
Bradamante drew a diagonal line.
With a swift sword that even unmanned warriors at 9-star level couldn't react to leisurely, Midor, a mage, could only flinch once.
He had exhausted his magic power blocking Murakan's attacks all along. He couldn't properly expand his protective shield anymore, nor could he gather strength for a counterattack.
The brother I trusted was in a panic, mumbling to himself even as the iron-armored warrior reached past him to thrust his sword at his younger sibling. He had completely lost it.
Splurt-! A fountain of blood erupted.
It was the fountain of blood that gushed as Midor's right arm was severed and his chest was sliced open. And between the crimson droplets, a gloomy blue cube emitting a blue light floated up.
Magical power with ice properties enveloped the cube.
'There must be a security measure in place to prevent leaks.'
As expected, it was there, like the mines of Viment that oxidized to leave no trace.
In the case of the cube, it was an explosion. In that brief moment, it detected a threat and was about to explode.
Hmm!
Temporarily planting Bradamante in the ground, he wrapped both hands, which had spread the ice seal, around the cube.
He couldn't help the explosion, but he embraced it in his chest to keep its original shape as much as possible while it exploded.

A tremendous noise occurred in front of his chest and hands. Despite the blessed strong body and spiritual armor, it was an intense explosion that felt like his fingers and chest bones were shattered.
Eventually, when he spread his hands, the cube was badly broken, but most of the parts remained intact.
'With this level of damage, it can be analyzed. By the world's top researchers.'
A satisfied smile appeared on his face.
On the other hand, Midor was screaming with his eyes wide open and his hair standing on end.
"Mu-ron, you idiot! Are you even a Jiffle, and can you disappoint me like this?! The years I've lived, vomiting blood for your revenge... It's so pathetic!"
Chk!
Midor pointed at Jin with the wand he had been holding in his left hand.
It was the wand of the Magic Tower Lord, and the rune letters calling for the main body were emitting light.
"You wanted to kill me? Fine, Jin Runecandel. Kill me. But my revenge will not end today."
Midor thought Jin had made a 'mistake'.
He said he couldn't calculate the wand of the Magic Tower Lord because he wanted to obtain the sample of the cube.
However, the reason Midor could activate the wand of the Magic Tower Lord was because Jin had deliberately left his left arm intact.
"In the age of ultra-regeneration and resurrection, it seems that death has become quite light for Jiffle. But Midor Elna, don't you think you've made a foolish move?"
Jin spoke as he walked towards Midor with big strides.
"Even if there were more broken cubes, calling the main body with that wand is way too slow, isn't it? By the time they arrive here, I'll already be at home taking a warm bath and eating dinner."
"If it hadn't been for Talares that day, you would have...!"
"If you ever appear before me again, I'll take it as evidence that Jiffle can resurrect even without a body. So let's not meet again, Midor Elna."
Swoosh!
Jin spoke as he slit Midor's throat.
